book.name: Joŋ
book.title: Saaka wù joŋe kune Jiso no Joŋ gɛ̀ Saŋ

content: Mɛɛle yefɛ Jiso Bɛtani
Gɛ̀ bee shege wa aju bvusoo mo nyu kife ki Ŋka wu Ndaŋfe, Jiso ja wu gɛɛŋ ntɛ wù Bɛtani le a Lasolo wù Jiso gɛ̀ bvusɛ wu yi kwe le gɛ̀ bee yo.
No wu gɛnɛ yo, bo fɛ mwɛɛ munjile ki bo tɛ wu yu. Mata gɛ̀ bee muh wu gabe Lasolo nyu muh mu ŋgoo yi bamii ba gɛ̀ shilɛ bo jii mwɛɛ bɛ Jiso le.

Mɛɛle ja wu jo fikaaŋ fi mɛɛ ma yefɛ mamu ma gwee wuŋ, wu chvu bikaa bi Jiso le, wu sho bɛ yvu ye yi kikwɛɛ. Mɛɛ maa gɛ̀ tɛɛme kwa baaŋ, ba gɛ̀ kɛnyi bɛ fiɛɛ fimi ba tɛŋe lɛ naad lɛwulɛwu. No wu chvu noo, yeh tu yi gwee wuŋ wù joŋe yichii.
Juda Ɛkaliot wù gɛ̀ bee muh ŋgoo yi booŋ ba Jiso le, (Wu gɛ̀ jiɛnyɛ wu to wu gesɛ wu) wu ja wu jɛmɛ lɛ,
“Be ge la lɛ keefɛ bo gêsɛ mɛɛ manɛ banchvuge gii yitɛde,
bo nya bige biyu bamii ba fuude le gɛ?”
Gɛ Juda gɛ̀ jɛme nɛ lɛ wù kɛme kiŋkoŋɛ fɛ bamii ba fuude le gɛ. Wu gɛ̀ bee choŋ wù nyu muh wuboo wu gɛɛde kikɛɛ, wu gɛ̀ leese chiaaŋ yo wu fiih kikwɛɛ ke yu.
Jiso jɛmɛ lɛ,

content.text: “Chînɛ wu le. Wu be gɛɛde mɛɛ manɛ ki wu sêesɛ nyu njiiyɛ waŋ yu.
Bamii ba fuude lé bo nyû gɛh bɛ bɛŋ segechii, geenɛ gɛ mɛ nyu ŋge nyume besabɛŋ segechii gɛ.”

content: Kinchvu ki Bajuu gɛ̀ yu lɛ Jiso le yo, bo mo bo to yo. Gɛ bo gɛ̀ too gɛh nje Jiso maa gɛ. Bo gɛ̀ too tɛ ki bo yɛŋ Lasolo wù Jiso gɛ̀ bvusɛ yi kwe le.
Noo, bachiji kintanyɛ ba baaŋ baaŋ tu bo kage lɛ bo lé bo yûuyɛ tɛ Lasolo,
nje gɛ̀ bee nje wu wù Bajuu ba duude gɛ̀ chinɛ wa bo le, bo leese fitele nyu yi Jiso le.
Jiso lee Yɛlusalɛm njɛ Nfoŋ
Lɛ akfuuŋ bu ayuu, kinchvu ki bamii ki gɛ̀ to fɛ ŋka wuyu le bo yu lɛ Jiso le a je wu too Yɛlusalɛm.

Bo mo bo jo bidaadɛ bo bu ki bo gɛɛŋ bo fi wu yu a je. No bo gɛ̀ gɛɛne noo bo wuule bo duu lɛ, “Yilili Yilili, mbɛɛŋsɛ nyûme fɛ Nyo le lɛɛɛ! Nyo le wu noŋ kimbonɛ yi muh wù too a jee chi Tada le lɛɛɛ! Le wu wu le Nfoŋ wu Ishwala lɛɛɛ!”
Jiso gooŋ mwa jaki, wu bɛɛŋ yu. Fi mo fi nyu no ba gɛ̀ saŋ lɛ,

content.text: “Bamii ba Sayoŋ, keefɛ bɛŋ fâane gɛ.
Bɛŋ jîŋɛ bɛŋ yɛ̂ŋ, Nfoŋ wene too lo,
wu le wu bɛɛŋ yi mwa jaki le.”

content: Gɛ booŋ ba Jiso ba ŋgoo gɛ̀ kɛɛ fɛŋkɛɛ fiɛɛ fì fiɛɛ finɛ gɛ̀ duunyi gɛ. No Jiso gɛ̀ leesɛ wa yi bvukugɛ bwe le, bo mo bo kwajɛ lɛ ba gɛ̀ saŋ fiɛɛ finɛ kune wu, fi gɛ̀ kooshɛ bɛ wu gɛh no ba gɛ̀ saŋ.
Kinchvu kì gɛ̀ bee bɛ Jiso juu chì wu gɛ̀ tɛŋe Lasolo a jɛŋ wu bvusɛ wu yi kwe le, gɛ̀ gɛɛne bo nsɛŋe no bo gɛ̀ yɛŋ.
Kinchvu kiyu gɛ̀ bu ki gɛɛŋ ki fi wu a je nje bo gɛ̀ yu lɛ wu gɛ̀ ge fiɛɛ finɛ fì duunyi bvukugɛ bvu Nyo.
Bafalashii yɛŋ nɛ bo tu bo jɛme lɛbolɛbo lɛ, “Bɛŋ le bɛŋ yɛŋ gɛ lo? Gɛ fiɛɛ nyu yu fì taŋlo bɛŋ ka bɛŋ ge gɛ. Woŋ wuchii le wu banyɛ wa wu bii wu le.”
Baglek bamu tu bo goone ki bo yɛŋ Jiso le
Bamii bamu gɛ̀ bee ŋgoo yi bamii ba gɛ̀ bɛnɛ Yɛlusalɛm ki bo bunɛ Nyo kife ki ŋka kinɛ le gɛ̀ bee Baglek.
Baglek banɛ gɛɛŋ bo yɛŋ Filib wù gɛ̀ ja a kilaantɛŋ kì Bɛsada le kimbe kì Galalee le, bo jɛmɛ wu le lɛ, “Ŋgamu, bee goone ki be yɛŋ Jiso le.”
Filib mo wu gɛɛŋ wu sɛɛŋ Andulu le, bɛ wu gɛɛŋ bo sɛɛŋ Jiso le.
Jiso chvuu bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Kife le ki kojɛ ka ki muh wù jee che le Mwamuh le wù kɛme jee chì kuge.
Nsɛŋe bɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ lɛ, ŋgo yi fiɛɛ baaŋ gwe gɛ yi nshɛŋ le yi kwe gɛ, yi mɛ gɛh yi maa. Geenɛ yi kwe lo, yi yuŋ muntaŋ wesee.
Muh wù koŋe kinche ke baaŋ lé wu gê wu lɛ̂sɛ kinche kiyu, muh wù banɛ kinche ke yi woŋ kfunɛ le wu lé wu gɛ̂ɛ lo ki, wu lé wu gê wu kɛ̂me kinche kì kage gɛ.
Nɛ muh lɛne mɛne, tu wù kɛme ki wu bîi mɛne, mo nyu faaŋ fɛ mɛ le fo, muh waŋ wu lɛme nyû tɛ fo. Nɛ muh lɛne mɛne, tu Chii le wu ge wu buuŋ wu.”

content: Jiso jɛmɛ kune kwe ye
Jiso ja wu jɛmɛ lɛ,

content.text: “Mɛɛse fitele fuuŋse lo mɛ. Taŋlo ndu lɛ la? Lɛ Chii bvusɛ mɛ antɛnɛɛ a kife ki ŋgɛ kinɛ le? Aay, le nje kife kiyu kinɛ kì ŋgɛ̀ nto.
Chii, gêe lɛ jee chuŋ kuge.”

content: No wu jɛmɛ noo, jɛ shii fɛwe lɛ, “Nle ŋge wa chi kuge, mbaaŋ ŋka ŋge.”
Kinchvu ki gɛ̀ lɛme fo doo ki yu jɛ yiyu, bo jɛmɛ fiboo lɛ, “Wame jaŋ.” Bamu jɛmɛ lɛ, “Jɛmɛ nchɛndaa wu Nyo wu le.”
Jiso chvuu lɛ,

content.text: “Jɛ yinɛ to nje bɛŋ. Gɛ yi to nje mɛ gɛ.
Mɛɛse le wa kife kì ba lé ba sâ woŋ kfunɛ. Mɛɛse ba lé ba shwâ nfoŋ wù sage woŋ kfunɛ.
Geenɛ fiaŋ le lɛ sege ba lé ba shɛ̂ŋshɛ mɛ fɛwe, nchii bamii bachii bo to yi ye yaŋ le.”

content: Jiso gɛ̀ jɛme noo wu duunyi nyu kfuu chi kwe yi wù gɛ̀ bee ki wu kwê.
Kinchvu ki bamii chvuu wu le lɛ, “Bee yuge a Ŋwa wu banchi le lɛ Mbvusɛ wù Nyo gɛ̀ ka lé wu gê wu fejɛ.” Fi jiɛnyi nɛɛ fɛ wo duu lɛ,

content.text: “Ba kɛme ki ba ge ba shɛ̂ŋshɛ Mwamuh fɛwe?”

content: Muh wù jee che le Mwamuh wɛɛ le wù la?
Jiso jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “N'yulɛ le wù nyu bɛ bɛŋ yi kife le shige. Bɛŋ mo bɛŋ jîɛnyi no bɛŋ kɛme n'yulɛ bɛ bɛŋ, keefɛ kijibɛ ja ki baŋe bɛŋ gɛ. Gɛ muh wu jiɛnyi kijibɛ le to wu kee fɛ wu gɛɛne fo gɛ.
No bɛŋ kɛme n'yulɛ bɛ bɛŋ, bɛŋ bɛɛŋ n'yulɛ wunɛ le, fi le lɛ bɛŋ mo bɛŋ nyu booŋ ba n'yulɛ.”

content: Jɛ yi Jiso lé yi gê yi sâ muh wu le wu faŋ ki wu fî jɛ yiyu No Jiso jɛmɛ mwɛɛ munɛ nɛ, wu mo wu ja wu gɛɛŋ wu nyilɛ.
Mo no wu gɛ̀ ge mwɛɛ wesee mu duunyi bvukugɛ bwe bo yɛŋ, bo gɛ̀ baaŋ leesɛ gɛ fitele yi ye ye le gɛ.
Fi gɛ̀ bee noo lɛ fi kojɛ no Yosaya wu muh wu ntuŋ wu Nyo gɛ̀ jɛmɛ lɛ,

content.text: “Tada, le yɛɛŋ wu le wu bɛɛŋ fiɛɛ fì bee jɛme le?
Le fɛ baaŋ le wu Tada le wu dunyɛ bvuŋga bvu kibo ke?”

content: Noo, tu gɛ taŋlo bo leesɛ fitele yi ye ye le gɛ, nje Yosaya gɛ̀ ka wu jɛmɛ kijusɛ kimu le lɛ,

content.text: “Wu le wu baŋ ajii aboo,
wu ge muntele muboo tu mu jiɛɛ,
wu lɛ keefɛ bo yɛ̂ne mwɛɛ le bɛ ajii aboo gɛ,
bo kee mwɛɛ a muntele muboo le gɛ,
bo kaasɛ bo tu jiŋ fɛ mɛne nfɛ̂ bo.”

content: Yosaya gɛ̀ jɛme mwɛɛ munɛ nje wu gɛ̀ yɛŋ wa bvukugɛ bvu Jiso le, wu mo wu jɛme kune wu.

Mo nyu no bamii gɛ̀ baaŋ leesɛ gɛ muntele yi Jiso le gɛ, bamii wesee bo gɛ̀ bee bikwɛɛ bi woŋ gɛ̀ leesɛ muntele yi ye ye le, geenɛ bo faŋ ki bo jɛme bɛ de yiboo, nje bo gɛ̀ faane Bafalashii lɛ keefɛ bo kûŋ bo yeh yi buunɛ le gɛ.
Bo gɛ faane noo nje bo gɛ koŋe ki bo kɛme mbɛɛŋsɛ nyu wù jade fɛ bamii le fede ki bo kɛme nyu wù jade fɛ Nyo le.
Jiso ja wu jaŋ fɛwɛɛwe wu jɛmɛ lɛ,

content.text: “Muh wù le wu leesɛ fitele yi ye yaŋ le, gɛ wu leese nyu yi ye yaŋ le gɛ. Wu leese nyu yi muh wu tuŋ mɛ le.
Muh nɛ yɛŋ mɛne, tu wu le wu yɛŋ nyu muh wu tuŋ mɛ le.
Nto woŋ kfunɛ le njɛ n'yulɛ, lɛ le yɛɛŋ wu le wu leesɛ fitele yi ye yaŋ le wu gɛ ka wu mɛ gɛh nyu yi kijibɛ le gɛ.
Muh yu jɛ yaŋ, wu baaŋ gɛɛ gɛ, ŋgɛ nsa wu gɛ, nje gɛ ŋgɛ̀ nto ki nsage bamii ba yi woŋ kfunɛ le lɛ bo gwe nsa gɛ. Nto ki Mbvusɛ lo bo.
Muh wu le wu ma mɛ wù faŋ ki wu fî jɛ yaŋ wù kɛme fiɛɛ fì lé fi gê fi sâ wu. Jɛ yi nle njɛme wu le, le fiɛɛ fì lé fi gê fi sâ wu wù gwe nsa juu chì kimɛsɛ.
Fi le noo nje gɛ njɛme nyu a bvuŋga bwaŋ le gɛ. Chii wù tuŋ mɛ le wu wù du lɛ njɛ̂me, nya wu fiɛɛ fì njɛ̂me, wu sɛŋe no njɛ̂me.
Ŋkee lɛ fiɛɛ fì wu du lɛ njɛ̂me le fi nyaa kinche kì kage gɛ. Noo, fiɛɛ fì njɛme le fi Chii duu lɛ njɛ̂me.”

footnotes.text: Bachvuge ba gii yitɛde banɛ le a jɛ yi Glek le lɛ “badanale gii yitɛde”.
